column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Marco's Childhood and Seraphim
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Ever since I was a child, I was especially inconspicuous among the many $$奴隷$$s...
Rather, I hated standing out in a strange way and being bullied, so I made myself inconspicuous.
But people with black $$羽$$ prize their own individuality so highly...
that they despise those who live like mere cogs above all else.
When I was young, I did not understand that.
As a result, eventually even my fellow $$奴隷$$s stopped associating with me...
I spent years of my childhood not speaking to anyone.
Yet $$セラフィム$$, the son of $$ケルビム$$...
lifted someone like me out of the depths of loneliness!
